He carried it to the kitchen, broke the neck with a knife, and unrolled a paper brittle as old skin. It held only a date and a girl's name, written in ink the salt had barely touched. Some messages, he thought, do not ask to be answered; they ask only to be found.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市浸在深蓝色的梦里。街道刚被雨洗过，路灯拖着湿光。早点铺升起白汽，蒸笼里的馒头慢慢鼓起。出租车从街口滑过，尾灯转瞬消失。高楼的窗大多黑着，零星几盏灯像迟归人的心事。风穿过楼群，带着江水的潮气。清洁工扫过街道，扫帚声细弱清醒。天还没亮，城市已悄悄翻身，露出温柔疲惫的一角。","w03":"• Recursion is when a story sends you back to the same kind of story, but with something a little smaller each time.\n• You repeat that smaller version until you reach a simple stopping case, like a doll with no smaller doll inside.\n• Then you bring each answer back outward, one layer at a time, until the original question is solved."}
